description: This file defines the internal sealed class ActivationDirectory, which manages a collection of grain activation contexts within the Orleans runtime. It provides methods for adding, removing, and finding grain contexts, as well as disposing of resources asynchronously or synchronously.

classes.name: ActivationDirectory
classes.description: Manages grain activation contexts, allowing addition, removal, lookup, and disposal of activations within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: ActivationDirectory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the activation directory and registers an observer for activation count.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Property that returns the current number of activations.

methods.name: FindTarget
methods.description: Finds and returns the grain context associated with the specified GrainId.

methods.name: RecordNewTarget
methods.description: Adds a new grain context to the directory and increments the activation count.

methods.name: RemoveTarget
methods.description: Removes a grain context from the directory and decrements the activation count.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator over the collection of grain contexts.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes all grain contexts, awaiting any asynchronous disposal methods.
